messages:
leo.support: FYI urgent from ClearBay — SSO provisioning failed during last step, they can't complete onboarding and said they'll pause rollout unless fixed. Renewal in ~6 weeks, customer is frustrated. Marking P1 for support.
jamie.csm: Ack. Thanks Leo. Can you paste error logs / screenshot and confirm if this is an IdP metadata mismatch or our provisioning API returning 5xx?
leo.support: Screenshot + last request log below. Looks like 502 from provisioning-service when we call /v1/sso/provision. Error: `upstream read timeout`. No IdP changes reported on their side.
jamie.csm: Ok — this is a high renewal-risk signal. We need a comms plan: 1) triage call within 2 hours 2) temporary workaround so they can finish onboarding (manual SSO link?) 3) daily status to customer until resolved 4) contingency (credit / 2-week extension) if not resolved by EOD tomorrow.
maria-renewals: +1 on contingency. I'll loop in sales to pause aggressive renewal outreach and prepare a small credit offer if we miss SLA.
sam.eng: I can take the provisioning-service trace. Assign me. Leo, can you share request ID and approximate time? I'll repro in staging and check upstream timeouts.
leo.support: Request ID 01FZ9Q2Y, timestamp 2026-03-15T09:12:22Z. Also here's the deploy bot note — deploy to provisioning-service around that time: oncall-bot: deploy service/provisioning v2.14 completed 2026-03-15T09:05:10Z.
sam.eng: Noted. Might be a regression from v2.14. I'll roll a canary rollback if I reproduce. ETA 1.5h for initial triage.
jamie.csm: Action items and owners: - Triage + repro: @sam.eng (1.5h) - Customer bridge call: @jamie.csm + @leo.support (30m) - Temporary onboarding workaround: @tara-ps (docs/session) (3h) - Renewal comms: @maria-renewals (prepare pause/offer) - Incident updates: @leo.support (every 4h)
tara-ps: I can provide a manual SSO link flow and a short enablement checklist. Will prepare and share with customer in next 2 hours.
maria-renewals: Drafting customer message to avoid escalation. Suggest messaging: we acknowledge the issue, working on a fix, offering a temporary manual onboarding path, will update in 4 hours. If not resolved by EOD tomorrow, we will offer a one-month credit. Want review before sending.
jamie.csm: Please use this draft and adapt: ```Hi [Name], thanks for flagging — we're actively investigating a provisioning issue blocking SSO setup. We've stood up an engineering triage and a manual onboarding path to keep your rollout on track. We'll update you by 1:00pm PT and will prioritize a full fix. Thank you for the patience — Jamie, CSM.```
leo.support: Sending initial triage invite now. Customer OK for 1:30pm PT bridge.
sam.eng: Reproduced timeout in staging when calling upstream auth-proxy. Root cause: connection pool exhaustion after v2.14 change. Opening rollback PR now.
jamie.csm: Great. Keep comms tight. Once rollback is live, verify with customer SSO flow and confirm they can proceed. If rollback not possible within 3h, escalate to infra and consider hotfix.
onchalant-note: :eyes: (reaction)
leo.support: Update — rollback PR merged and deployed to canary at 10:18am PT. I've notified customer that we're doing a targeted fix.
sam.eng: Canary looks healthy, no timeouts in the next 20m. Rolling to prod with 10m monitoring window.
leo.support: Customer confirmed SSO success at 10:42am PT and completed onboarding steps. They appreciated the responsiveness.
jamie.csm: Excellent. Next steps: - Postmortem with eng (sam) and support (leo) due tomorrow - Update onboarding doc to include canary checklist - Maria, check renewal cadence next week and see if we keep original terms or offer small concession.
maria-renewals: I'll hold off outreach until after postmortem. If they express concerns in next check-in, I'll present the one-month credit option.
jamie.csm: Thanks everyone — closing loop here. I'll drop the final comms and postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
